name: Original escape response across Hackdirt boundary, normal walking held until conversation

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ChorrolNorthernGoodsAndTrade::ref=0x0280fa::side=south
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=hackdirt-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<0.1 then return end;timer=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died crossing town boundary')
 local a=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x280fa));assert(a and a:isValid(),'Dar-Ma missing');assert(not Actor.isDead(a),'Dar-Ma died crossing boundary')
 print('EscapeCross player='..tostring(self.position)..' darma='..tostring(a.position)..' darmaCell='..a.cell.name..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(a).current)
 if core.isWorldPaused() then return end
 local v=util.vector3(-68418.5390625,65691.8515625,9898)-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local angle=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y)
 if math.abs(angle)<0.05 and math.abs(camera.getPitch())<0.04 then print('EscapeCross ready') end
 print(string.format('EscapeCross aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*128+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*128+.5)))))
end}}}}
